agent.problem: Several non-opening story cards exceed the two-sentence limit: stop 1 card 7 and stop 2 cards 1 and 2 each have three sentences, while stop 2 card 8 has four.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The preceding setup only establishes that there is a warning; the picture of barbs and thorns does not come until the next card. Nothing already shown lets the baker reason out "harass" rather than "outnumber" or "betray," so this blank tests unseen wording.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The question relies on the preceding, now-hidden cards to identify "those people." The question itself needs to identify them as the inhabitants of Canaan whom Israel might allow to remain.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
